{{Top|leg}}
The '''''ghet'bur'''''<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>, or gorget, is a piece of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that protects the throat and forms part of the [[haalas]]<ref name="TBHC" />, or cuirass. An earlier piece of armor, the '''''[[jatne ghet'bur]]'''''<ref name="TBHC" />, or upper gorget, served a similar purpose but was too restrictive and could hinder movement, and was rarely used by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TBHC" />.
